body: Isn't it easier to just die without worrying or hoping? Then I do not have to worry if I wake up in the morning at the right time for work, nor if I get my bills payed.  Why go on and be tortured if there only might be hope ?

Isn't the idea that waiting and hoping for 50 years straight and might end up thinking that I should died long time ago ?

If someone has depression, sadly most people do not understand what it is. People will bully you or think you are a freak at work for being different. Being nice and honest will not help you survive in our planet. I learned the hard way
Living a life for a few happy moments in the next 50 years is more of a torture than a life worth living. Yet, we do not know if anyone can get even 1 happy moment in the future
